name: gdu
description: Pretty fast disk usage analyzer with console interface written in Go, optimized for SSD performance with parallel processing

gdu.description: Fast disk usage analyzer with interactive TUI, parallel processing, and comprehensive filesystem analysis capabilities
gdu.usage:
gdu # Analyze current directory
gdu /path/to/analyze # Analyze specific path
gdu --show-disks # Show all mounted disks
gdu --no-hidden # Ignore hidden directories
gdu --non-interactive # Non-interactive mode
gdu --output-file report.json # Export analysis
